svg.title: Mercury, cratered terrain
svg.desc: Static vector contours derived from the MESSENGER Mercury globe PIA15160, centred at 0 degrees north and 0 degrees east. Recoloured as a decorative enhanced-colour interpretation with blue-teal terrain, pale rays and muted gold crater highlights. Credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Carnegie Institution of Washington. Source: https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/mercury-globe-0n-0e/.
